scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api && npm run build:worker
scripts.build:api: node scripts/run-uv.mjs --project apps/api run python -m compileall -q apps/api/app packages/observability/src scripts/db
scripts.build:worker: node scripts/run-uv.mjs --project apps/worker run python -m compileall -q apps/worker/app
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api && npm run lint:worker
scripts.lint:api: node scripts/run-uv.mjs --project apps/api run ruff check apps/api/app apps/api/tests packages/observability/src scripts/db
scripts.lint:worker: node scripts/run-uv.mjs --project apps/worker run ruff check apps/worker/app apps/worker/tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:worker
scripts.typecheck:api: node scripts/run-uv.mjs --project apps/api run mypy apps/api/app packages/observability/src scripts/db
scripts.typecheck:worker: node scripts/run-uv.mjs --project apps/worker run mypy apps/worker/app
scripts.test: npm run test:records && npm run test:ci && npm run test:web && npm run test:api && npm run test:worker
scripts.test:ci: node --test scripts/test/account-bootstrap-contract.test.js scripts/test/architecture-hardening-contract.test.js scripts/test/auth-contract.test.js scripts/test/ci-config.test.js scripts/test/deployment-config.test.js scripts/test/membership-resolution-contract.test.js scripts/test/observability-contract.test.js scripts/test/project-api-contract.test.js scripts/test/project-domain-contract.test.js scripts/test/secret-scan.test.js scripts/test/staging-migration-cicd.test.js scripts/test/tenant-context-contract.test.js
scripts.test:api: node scripts/run-uv.mjs --project apps/api run pytest -q apps/api/tests
scripts.test:worker: node scripts/run-uv.mjs --project apps/worker run pytest -q apps/worker/tests
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate
